risk_summary: The excerpt is generally detailed and quantitatively specific, but its lengthy ownership, restructuring, and financing descriptions are highly complex and include repeated hotel-management disclosures. Key risks include substantial mortgage obligations, redemption payables, refinancing dependence, related-party management arrangements, and uncertainty regarding recovery of the disputed documentary transfer tax. Management expresses confidence in liquidity and asset values, though this is partly qualified by reliance on future cash flows and potential additional borrowing.
